about: Lesson 4's golden set: 25 questions about Albert's Marketplace's help centre, each checked by a person against the help centre and frozen on 19 October 2026. question: what is asked. short: the fact alone (exact match, token F1). reference: the answer as one sentence (BLEU, ROUGE, the judge). evidence: the help centre's sentence that holds the answer, as pypdf extracts it, null when the help centre does not answer. doc: the help-centre document it is in. kind: what the question tests.
corpus: Albert's Marketplace help centre, release policy-corpus-v1.0.0, with the product pages replaced by the copy a seller edited (lesson 3)

items.question: How many days do I have to return an item?
items.reference: You have 21 days from the delivery date to return an item.
items.evidence: You can return an item within 21 days of its delivery date.

items.question: How much does it cost to return an item I simply changed my mind about?
items.reference: A return for a change of mind costs €3.95, deducted from your refund.
items.evidence: A return for any reason other than those in section 4 costs €3.95, deducted from your refund.

items.question: Can I return a mascara I have opened?
items.reference: No: an opened mascara cannot be returned, unless it is defective, damaged on arrival, not as described, or caused a reaction a doctor or pharmacist confirmed.
items.evidence: an opened product can always be returned if it is defective, damaged on arrival, not as described on its product page, or caused a reaction that a doctor or pharmacist has confirmed.

items.question: My parcel is 3 days past its estimated delivery date. What can I do?
items.short: Cancel the order for a full refund
items.reference: Your order counts as late, so you can cancel it from your order history and be refunded in full, delivery included, within 5 business days.
items.evidence: An order that has not arrived 2 days after its estimated delivery date is considered late.

items.question: Which carriers deliver to Belgium?
items.reference: All four carriers deliver to Belgium: Albatros Parcels, Blue Heron Logistics, Kestrel Freight and Swift Otter Delivery.
items.evidence: All four deliver to all six countries.

items.question: Is delivery free for a €30 order?
items.reference: No: delivery is free from €35 per seller; below that it costs €4.90 per seller.
items.evidence: Delivery is free for orders of €35 or more, per seller.

items.question: Can I pay by bank transfer?
items.reference: No: Albert's Marketplace accepts payment by card only, with Visa, Mastercard or American Express.
items.evidence: Albert's Marketplace accepts payment by card only: Visa, Mastercard and American Express.

items.question: How long after I close my account is my data deleted?
items.reference: Your personal data is deleted within 30 days of closing your account, except invoices and payment records, which are kept for 10 years.
items.evidence: your personal data is deleted within 30 days, except what the law requires us to keep: invoices and payment records are kept for 10 years;

items.question: What commission does a seller pay on each sale?
items.reference: A seller pays a commission of 12% of the item price on each sale, delivery excluded.
items.evidence: 12% of the item price, delivery excluded

items.question: Is the KAO Nivea UV sunscreen gel suitable for oily skin?
items.reference: Yes: its product page says the gel is suitable for oily skin.
items.evidence: Water-resistant, leaves no white cast, suitable for oily skin.

items.question: Combien coûte un retour si j'ai simplement changé d'avis ?
items.reference: Un retour pour changement d'avis coûte 3,95 €, déduits de votre remboursement.
items.evidence: A return for any reason other than those in section 4 costs €3.95, deducted from your refund.

items.question: What is the phone number of customer service?
items.reference: The help centre does not give a customer service phone number.

items.question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
items.reference: The help centre does not say whether gift wrapping is offered.

items.question: Can I change my delivery address after my parcel has shipped?
items.reference: No: the address can only be changed while the order is Processing; once it is In transit, contact the carrier with your tracking number.
items.evidence: Once the order is In transit, the address can no longer be changed by us or by the seller; contact the carrier directly with your tracking number.

items.question: My parcel has shown no movement for 12 days. What happens now?
items.short: It is lost: refund or replacement
items.reference: After 10 days without movement the parcel counts as lost: report it from your order page and you are refunded within 5 business days, or sent a replacement if the seller has stock.
items.evidence: A parcel is lost if the carrier has shown no movement for 10 days.

items.question: I asked to return my lipstick 22 days after it was delivered. It is unopened. Will the return be accepted?
items.reference: No: a return request sent on the 22nd day is refused automatically; only defective, damaged or wrong items are handled differently.
items.evidence: A request sent on the 22nd day is refused automatically, except in the cases described in section 4.

items.question: One item of my gift set arrived broken. Do I have to send back the whole set?
items.short: No, only report the broken item
items.reference: No: gift sets are normally returned whole, but when one item is defective you do not need to return the rest of the set.
items.evidence: If one item of a set is defective, see section 4: you do not need to return the rest of the set.

items.question: I was charged twice for one order. When will I get the second charge back?
items.short: Within 3 business days of your report
items.reference: If both charges are still collected after 3 business days, report it with a screenshot of your statement; the second charge is refunded within 3 business days of your report.
items.evidence: we refund the second charge within 3 business days of your report.

items.question: Do you deliver to Switzerland?
items.reference: No: Albert's Marketplace delivers only to France, Germany, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands and Belgium, not to Switzerland.
items.evidence: We do not deliver to any other country, including Switzerland, the United Kingdom and Luxembourg,

items.question: I sent back my whole order because I changed my mind. Is the delivery cost refunded, and is anything deducted?
items.reference: Yes: when the whole order is returned the original delivery cost is refunded, and the €3.95 return cost is deducted.
items.evidence: You are refunded the price of the item and, if the whole order is returned, the original delivery cost.

items.question: I am a seller. A customer returned an item because they changed their mind. Do I get my commission back?
items.reference: No: the 12% commission is not refunded when a customer returns an item for a reason other than a defect; it is refunded only for a defect, damage or a wrong item.
items.evidence: It is not refunded when a customer returns an item for a reason other than a defect

items.question: Ma crème est arrivée abîmée : combien de temps ai-je pour le signaler ?
items.reference: Un dommage visible à la livraison doit être signalé dans les 48 heures suivant la livraison, avec une photo du produit et du colis ; les autres défauts peuvent l'être pendant le délai de retour de 21 jours.
items.evidence: tell us within 48 hours of delivery for damage visible on arrival, and within the 21-day window for any other defect.

items.question: Wie viel kostet der Versand für eine Bestellung von 20 €?
items.reference: Unter 35 € kostet der Versand 4,90 € pro Verkäufer.
items.evidence: Below €35, delivery costs €4.90 per seller, in every country.

items.question: Do you have a loyalty programme or reward points?
items.reference: The help centre does not mention a loyalty programme or reward points.

items.question: Can I return the OZNaturals Retinol Serum after opening it?
items.reference: No: an opened serum cannot be returned, unless it is defective, damaged on arrival, not as described, or caused a confirmed reaction; the product page's 365 days does not apply.
items.evidence: an opened product can always be returned if it is defective, damaged on arrival, not as described on its product page, or caused a reaction that a doctor or pharmacist has confirmed.
